findings.finding: streams is populated during registration. A first-pipe set_blocking/register failure omits the second child pipe from finally cleanup. An unguarded pipe.close exception can also bypass remaining pipes, selector cleanup and final receipt.
findings.minimal_remedy: Record both child pipes before any setup operation, or close both child-owned handles from finally irrespective of registration; independently guard closes so an error preserves HOLD and does not bypass the other handles/receipt. No process-group or framework expansion.

findings.finding: The 32768-byte check follows extending the retained buffer by up to4096 bytes, so a cap violation can retain36864 bytes while the intent says32768 per pipe.
findings.minimal_remedy: Check prospective retained length before extending, or explicitly and accurately declare a bounded one-chunk overflow instead of a strict32768 cap.

findings.finding: The collector records credential-context ENV key presence only and does not itself open credential files, but passes existing auth/config context to gh. Normal gh authentication may consult that context, including existing credential config. The no-credential-file-reads wording must not be read as a child-wide guarantee.
findings.minimal_remedy: Clarify that this is no direct credential-file/value probing or disclosure, with normal retained-context gh authentication separately allowed by root; otherwise the normal-auth scope needs a decision before execution.

method: Read all 166 source lines as retained bytes/text and independently hash them. No helper execution/import/AST/compilation, Git, network, process/runtime/SDK probe, build/test, source capture, stop, cleanup or replay. Only this own-lane source-review artifact is written.

The two executable inspections are fixed /usr/bin/gh and /usr/bin/curl: bounded regular root-owned executable bytes, no final symlink, before/fd-after/path pin equality and SHA256; curl is not invoked.

Own /proc/self/ns/{pid,mnt} readlinks only; environment output is presence booleans for HOME/GH_CONFIG_DIR/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN. Known auth/proxy context is passed unlogged, not included in receipts.

stdin DEVNULL, close_fds, nonblocking selected pipes; cancel/deadline/cap/API/schema errors retain consumed HOLD; only the original direct unreaped child is conditionally killed and then waited. No name/group kill or assertion of abnormal-descendant absence.
